title: Scooter
creator: CrossFit
description: With a partner on a 35-minute clock: a 30-minute AMRAP of 30 double-unders, 15 pull-ups, 15 push-ups and a 100 m sprint, alternating full rounds, then five minutes to find a 1-rep-max partner deadlift. Honours Hayward Police Sgt. Scott Lunger, shot during a traffic stop in 2015. Solo athletes rest 60 seconds between rounds and find a normal deadlift max.
